SymbolicEssence.ArchetypalFunction: To embody violent death and battlefield carnage; to feast on the blood of the slain; collective spirits of brutal ends.
SymbolicEssence.SymbolicCore: Violent death personified, the spirits that feast on slaughter, doom in battle.

CulturalContext.ReligiousOrRitualUse: Feared and propitiated; associated with violent death vs peaceful passing.
CulturalContext.HistoricalEvolution: Ancient death spirits; represent brutal vs gentle death; plural collective entity.

SymbolicRepresentation.ImageryNotes: Depicted as dark winged female spirits with claws, hovering over battlefields, drinking blood of the slain.
SymbolicRepresentation.PoeticInvocation: Keres, dark-winged harvesters of the battlefield, who drink the blood of violent ends.
SymbolicRepresentation.DreamForm: Dark winged figures circling overhead, waiting for the moment of violent death

MetaIntegration.RitualFunction: Shadow work with violence; honoring war dead; processing trauma of violent loss.
AIPromptSeeds: The death spirits who feast on battlefield carnage.
Dark fates of violent end, wings black as night.
